menu_research_note: CRITICAL GAP: the full 12-service priced menu could NOT be recovered. The Fresha location has isBookable:false ('Bookings offline'), which hides the per-service price/duration list from the rendered page in every fetch method attempted: (1) raw curl with a Chrome user-agent, (2) curl with a Googlebot user-agent (in case of SEO pre-rendering), (3) the WebFetch tool directly on the listing URL, (4) locating and fetching the Fresha booking-flow URL (/book-now/.../all-offer) whose embedded __NEXT_DATA__ also returned an empty fallback cache (services load via a client-side GraphQL call after hydration, which cannot be executed without a real headless browser, unavailable in this environment per the same limitation noted in this repo's alabaster-esthetics-fort-myers/data.json), (5) probing api.fresha.com/graphql and the site's own /_proxy/graphql endpoint directly (415/404, schema unknown). Web-search-engine summaries did surface additional plausible service names (Volume Cluster Lashes, Half/Full Leg Wax, alternate durations for Basic Facial/Back Facial) but returned DIFFERENT prices/durations for the identical service across separately repeated queries, indicating those figures are not reliably grounded in the source page and were deliberately excluded rather than risk inventing data. Only the 5 services already supplied in the task brief are used, plus the structurally-confirmed count (12) and max price ($60).

gate_failure_reason: Zero real photographs of the studio, treatments, results, or practitioner exist on any public channel for this business. The Fresha listing (its only public presence anywhere) contains a single image, and that image is the business's logo/monogram graphic, not a photograph, so it cannot be used as a gallery tile, hero image, or 'about' image under this pipeline's own curation rules (no text/graphic overlays, no logos as gallery content). No Instagram, Facebook, Yelp, Birdeye, GlowRoute, or independent website exists to supplement it, and Google Maps' own photos could not be retrieved (JS-rendered, blocked to headless/curl fetch in this environment). This falls well below the 'fewer than 5 usable real photos' threshold at which the pipeline instructs marking FAILED rather than padding with non-real imagery. Additionally, the Fresha listing itself has bookings turned off ('isBookable: false'), which hides its own full priced service menu from every fetch method available, compounding the data gap (only 5 of the 12 real services could be confirmed, sourced from the task brief, with matching structural confirmation of serviceCount=12 and priceMax=$60).
